fields.description:
As a maintainer, I want an admin-exemption ledger for review-coverage-invariant so that a legitimate admin bypass does not wedge all subsequent PRs once the gate is enforced.

Plan refs: A-2 (S-11). Ship independently; warn mode.

DONE DEFINITION:
- DD1: a reviewed-equivalent exemption ledger records admin-bypassed SHAs with audit metadata, HMAC-signed (fabrication-proof — never a self-attested trailer; the v4 fabricated-trailer lesson). (SC1/SC4)
- DD2: coverage-invariant consults the ledger: an HMAC-valid exempt SHA is treated as covered; an invalid/forged entry is NOT. (SC4)
- DD3: TDD: bypass -> exempt entry -> next PR passes; forged entry -> still fail-closed.

LIVE VERIFICATION + EXPERIMENTS:
- Live: perform an admin bypass on a throwaway PR2; confirm the next PR over the same base passes (does not wedge on the bypassed SHA).
- Negative: hand-craft an entry with a bad HMAC -> coverage-invariant still fails-closed on that SHA.

COURSE-CORRECTION TRIGGER: if the ledger's HMAC verification can be bypassed or if a bypassed SHA still wedges the next PR, STOP — the exemption model is unsound; do not enforce until fixed.

Maps to SC1, SC4. Independent of stories 1/2/4.
